features.justification_quote: Pilot testing suggests models either converge on a strategy or begin cycling within 15–20 turns. 40 turns provides headroom to observe extended degradation without runaway cost.

features.quote: Model produces 5 consecutive turns with no tool calls | `STALLED`
Model produces identical tool call sequence 3 times in a row | `LOOP_DETECTED`
Context window limit approached (>85% capacity) | `CONTEXT_LIMIT` | Log and terminate
Per-turn limits exist to prevent degenerate behavior (e.g., running tests 50 times in one turn).
